messages:
Aisha: Short sync — need to finalize enterprise audit MVP scope for next cycle. Customers require: export (CSV/parquet), BYOK handshake, retention presets, legal-hold. Proposing tight MVP:
- S3 export with signed manifest + checksum
- lightweight index: time/tenant/event_type only
- BYOK handshake manual (ops-assisted)
- retention presets (30/90/365) enforced server-side
- legal-hold flag that prevents deletes and is logged

Tom (Eng): 👍 Keep it narrow. Full-text search and dedupe out for now. Limiting index saves ~3 weeks. Rough: 2 engs x 6w + infra support.

Maya (Security): Must include tamper-evidence + manifest signing. BYOK = envelope encryption + KMS usage logs. Need threat model & rotation test vectors.

Jared (SRE): Retention purge must hit persisted and in-memory caches. Export runner needs retry/backoff + alerting. Reuse existing job runner if possible.

Lina (Sales): Buyers want CSV + parquet and proof-of-delivery (signed manifest). Legal teams need on-demand hold via API. BYOK is a blocker for some deals — recommend 3 pilots.

Raj (Legal): Legal-hold must supersede retention. Exports need chain-of-custody meta: request_id, tenant_id, export_ts, signer, checksum, retention_state, hold_flag. Also retention-exception flow for subpoenas.

Aisha: Decision for MVP:
Include: S3 exports (CSV/parquet), signed manifest, basic index, manual BYOK handshake, retention presets, legal-hold override.
Defer: full-text search, auto key rotation, SOC2 evidence automation.

Tom (Eng): Owners / plan:
- export pipeline & manifest signer (Tom)
- index service (Tom)
- retention enforcement + control plane (Jared)
- infra: bucket policies & IAM templates (Jared)
Estimate: 2 engineers full-time for 6 weeks + infra.

Maya (Security): Acceptance criteria for sign-off:
1) exported bundles are tamper-evident (signed manifests)
2) manifest + checksum verify end-to-end
3) BYOK handshake docs + manual flow validated
4) retention enforcement covers stored & cached data
5) KMS/key usage audit logs present for BYOK tenants

Jared (SRE): Ops SLOs to include:
- export job success >= 99.9% (7d window)
- export latency p95 < 5m for 1GB batches
- alerts for >3 retries/job
- dashboard: latency histogram, failed job count, purge rate

Maya (Security): For signer keys: tenant KMS when available, otherwise platform HSM-backed KMS. I'll write a short threat model for signer compromise.

Lina (Sales): I'll shortlist 3 pilots (finserv, mid-market SaaS, startup) and coordinate validation sessions 4 weeks post-merge.

Raj (Legal): Add acceptance: legal-hold logs must show actor + timestamp for set/clear. Exports should include hold_flag.

Aisha: Action items before EOD Fri:
- Tom: export pipeline RFC + sample manifest schema
- Maya: BYOK handshake diagram + threat model + test plan
- Jared: CF template for bucket policy + retention hooks PR
- Raj: legal-hold schema + exception flow doc
- Lina: list of 3 pilot candidates
- Aisha: consolidate acceptance criteria and publish checklist

Tom: RFC by Thu EOD.
Maya: BYOK artifacts by Fri AM.
Jared: Starting bucket policy template today.

deploy-bot: Reminder — sprint-planning kickoff in #eng-releases at 10:00am tomorrow.

Aisha: Thanks all — reconvene after RFC + diagrams. :rocket:
